CameraFi Studio Redesign

A clearer creator workspace that helps streamers find the right broadcasting tools at the right moment.

Year

2023

Role

UX/UI Design Intern (Design Contribution: 95%)

Background & Challenge

USER PROBLEM
New creators saw too many advanced broadcasting options on the first screen and dropped off before setup.
BUSINESS GOAL & CONSTRAINTS
Improve first-session activation, increase dashboard creation, raise homepage CTR by 25%, and keep page load under 1.5 seconds.
CORE DESIGN HYPOTHESIS
“Hiding advanced settings behind contextual FAB actions and adding an interactive simulator would help users understand core features faster.”

"Instead of showing every feature upfront, we revealed advanced tools only when the user was ready to act."

Research & Insights

We asked where the first experience felt difficult, then checked the findings with 45 external users, 14 employees, and onboarding A/B tests.

Overloaded First Screen

The issue was not missing features. Users needed fewer visible choices and a clearer path to start.

Clarity Before Features

Homepage clarity and brand identity were the biggest blockers. An interactive simulator could explain the product faster than long descriptions.

Brand Renewal

The redesign needed both a simpler structure and a cleaner visual identity.

Survey: What Blocks First-Time Users?

Which area should be clarified first to reduce onboarding friction?

Users were not asking for more features. They needed a clearer first screen, stronger identity, and easier entry points.

Design Strategy

We established a three-pronged design strategy to reduce cognitive load and deliver a modernized, cohesive experience.

Strategy

FAB-Based UI Restructuring

Transitioned from displaying all features at once to a contextual reveal. The floating action button shows only context-relevant creation options (Real-Time Caption · Scoreboard · Event), minimizing decision fatigue.

Strategy

IA Redesign

Simplified navigation (Home · Events · My Channel · More) and grouped related features. Rebuilt the information hierarchy based on actual usage frequency to streamline broadcasting setups.

Strategy

Brand System Renewal

Transitioned from a function-centric to a value-oriented UI representing trust, expertise, and speed. Delivered a clean logo redesign and a unified brand system with consistent fonts, colors, and microcopy.

Validation

1. A/B Testing: Icon-Centric Grid (A) vs. Text-Heavy Chips (B)

We compared icon-centric grid chips with text-heavy chips for sports category selection. Version B (Text-Heavy Chips) was selected as the winner; in fast-paced live environments, text-heavy chips minimized cognitive load and enabled instant recognition, raising setup CTR by 28% and completion rate by 34%.

Version A: Icon-Centric Grid
Version B: Text-Heavy Chips (Winner)

Outcome

IA & flow redesign (CTR ↑ 28%, session time ×1.6)

Simplified the IA and key feature flows with clear task mapping. Users navigated faster, raising CTR by 28% and average session duration by 1.6x.

From UX Renewal to Global Recognition (CES 2024 Feedback)

At CES 2024, visitors said the complex features felt well organized and the landing page made core functions easy to understand. The feedback confirmed that clearer UX can build trust and support business value.
